Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing the proper disposal of legal amounts of marijuana inadvertently left at retail stores holding a pharmacy license.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the proper disposal of legal amounts ofmarijuana inadvertently left at retail stores holding a pharmacylicense; and adding a new section to chapter 69.50 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 69.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Upon finding one ounce or less of marijuana inadvertently left ata retail store holding a pharmacy license, the store manager oremployee must promptly notify the local law enforcement agency or theWashington state patrol. After notification to the local lawenforcement agency or the Washington state patrol, the store manager oremployee must properly dispose of the marijuana.
